crossRefs.note: Therefore Jews took up stones again to stone him.
They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders…
When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

translations.web: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”
translations.bsb: “Rabbi,” they replied, “the Jews just tried to stone You, and You are going back there?”
translations.kjv: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
translations.asv: The disciples say unto him, Rabbi, the Jews were but now seeking to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
